author: reek
body: Capability and identity revocation for the trust lattice. Replaces the legacy web's CRL/OCSP infrastructure with signed revocation records propagated through the trust lattice.

author: reek
body: There are no certificate revocation lists. Revocation is event- based: a revocation record is a signed fact in the trust lattice, propagated the same way name records propagate.

author: reek
body: Revocation records are serialized for transmission over data channels or storage in the fact store.
